chunks: And Ali عليه السلام would take pride over the companions and say:

"Who among you is like me, while I am the partner of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله in his sacrificial offering? Who among you is like me, while I am the one whose sacrificial offering the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله slaughtered with his own hand."

key_terms.الصَّحَابَةِ: the companions of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.شَرِيكُ: a partner or one sharing in an act
key_terms.هَدْيِهِ: his sacrificial offering sent for hajj
key_terms.يَفْتَخِرُ: speaks proudly of a distinction or virtue

ai.seo_question: What special merit of Imam Ali عليه السلام is mentioned regarding the Prophet’s sacrificial offering in hajj?
ai.summary: This report describes Imam Ali عليه السلام speaking of a unique distinction granted to him in relation to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله during the rites of hajj. It highlights his singular virtue among the companions through his association with the Prophet’s sacrificial offering.
